FAQ

Questions? Straight answers.

How much does lawn care cost?

Every yard is different — we price by size, condition, and the work you want done. That's why quotes are always free: tell us about your yard and we'll give you an exact number with no obligation and no surprise add-ons.

What is a maintenance contract?

A maintenance contract is a standing schedule — weekly or biweekly — at a locked-in rate. You never have to think about it, you get priority on the schedule, and you pay less per visit than booking one-off cleanups.

Do you really offer discounts for veterans and seniors?

Yes — veterans, all first responders, and senior citizens get a discount on every service, from regular mowing to pressure washing. Just mention it when you request your quote.

Do I need to be home while you work?

Usually not. As long as we can access the yard — gates unlocked or codes left with us, pets secured — we'll handle everything and lock up when we're done. We'll let you know when your visit is scheduled.

What happens if it rains on my service day?

We shift the schedule and fit you in as soon as conditions allow — wet mowing tears up turf, so we won't do a bad cut just to check a box. We'll keep you posted on the new day.

Do you bundle services into one visit?

Absolutely — that's the advantage of one crew. Need the yard mowed, gutters cleared, and the driveway washed? Ask for it in your quote request and we'll handle it all in one trip where possible.
